notablePrerequisites:
Lunarch Veteran can be on the battlefield transformed.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
